$comment: Waiting for components that haven't landed: checkbox-demo and checkbox-rtl (Field and Label), checkbox-invalid, checkbox-basic, checkbox-description, checkbox-disabled and checkbox-group (Field), checkbox-table (Table). The Checkbox page shows Joinery's own checkbox-native and checkbox-indeterminate until then; they have no upstream counterpart, so they aren't mapped. The units that land Field, Label and Table port these examples onto the Checkbox page and map them here.
